backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing user profile management, role-based access control with a hardcoded admin principal, and admin management endpoints including profile CRUD, role queries, and concept machine visibility toggling.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping five chart animation features (CO2, Temperature, CoolingHeatingVentilation, FanVoltageFlowControl, TSICSensor) to their respective component files, each requiring `isAnimationActive={false}` on Recharts series components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing short summaries of all frontend source files, describing each component's purpose, data flow, and key implementation details for build planning reference.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark color themes including chart, sidebar, and UI component color tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell with the document title set to 'Conceptmachine Live Data' that mounts the React app via a module script pointing to src/main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component implementing default-deny admin access gating, page filtering based on ConceptMachine visibility, hardcoded Google Sheets URLs passed to the title bar, and routing between log system pages and the profile page.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: UI component that renders either a spinning 'Checking Access' loader or an 'Access Denied' card with a profile navigation button depending on the `isCheckingAccess` prop.
frontend/src/components/AuthControls.tsx: Empty file with no content, likely a placeholder for authentication control UI components.
frontend/src/components/CO2Chart.tsx: A Recharts-based line chart component displaying CO2 sensor data (right, left, CSV) over time with drag-to-zoom and brush range selection support.
frontend/src/components/CoolingHeatingVe: A line chart component showing cooling, heating, and ventilation percentages over time, derived from voltage/PWM data, with drag-to-zoom and brush range selection.
frontend/src/components/DashboardCard.ts: A reusable card layout component with a styled header, optional header action slot, and content area for dashboard sections.
frontend/src/components/FanVoltageFlowCo: A dual-axis line chart displaying fan voltages (fan1–3) on the left axis and flow control pressure on the right axis, with drag-to-zoom and brush range selection.
frontend/src/components/LogSystemTitleBa: A responsive title bar for log system pages featuring navigation arrows, theme toggle, refresh, download (admin-only), and a mobile sheet menu with profile/sign-out actions.
frontend/src/components/ProfileMenu.tsx: A dropdown menu component for authenticated users that shows their name and principal, with options to copy the principal, navigate to account settings, or sign out.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A modal dialog that prompts new users to enter their name to complete initial profile setup, submitting via the saveUserProfile mutation.
frontend/src/components/TemperatureChart: A Recharts line chart component displaying filtered and CSV temperature data over time, with drag-to-zoom, brush range selection, and automatic Y-axis domain adjustment.
A Recharts-based line chart component for visualizing multiple TSIC sensor data points with support for drag-to-zoom, brush range selection, sensor visibility toggling, and configurable Y-axis bounds.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A React Query hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor, initializing access control with an admin token and invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminList.ts: A React Query hook that fetches the list of all admins from the backend actor, enabled only when the caller is confirmed as an admin.
frontend/src/hooks/useConceptMachineVisi: Provides two hooks: one to query the ConceptMachine page visibility from the backend, and a mutation hook to update it, with cache invalidation on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: A React Query hook that fetches the current caller's user profile from the backend actor, returning loading and fetched states alongside the profile data.
A hook that subscribes to the React Query cache and returns a formatted timestamp string reflecting when the 'temperature-series' query was last updated.
frontend/src/hooks/useGoogleSheetsDownlo: A React Query hook that fetches and indefinitely caches the Google Sheets download link from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context provider and hook using DFINITY's AuthClient, managing login, logout, and identity persistence across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsCallerAdmin.ts: A React Query hook that checks whether the current caller is an admin via the backend actor, defaulting to false on any error and caching the result for 30 seconds.
frontend/src/hooks/useLogSystemNavigatio: A stateful hook managing navigation between log system pages, supporting next/previous cycling and direct navigation by page ID.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Exports React Query mutation hooks for saving a user profile and granting admin roles, with cache invalidation on success, plus re-exports useCurrentUserProfile.
frontend/src/hooks/useSyncedTimeWindow.t: Custom hook that manages a shared time window (zoom range) by index, exposing helpers to set, reset, and query the visible range across charts.
Custom hook that fetches and caches temperature/CO2 series data via React Query, tracking the last successful update time and disabling auto-refresh.
frontend/src/hooks/useThemeSession.ts: Custom hook that persists and toggles dark/light mode in sessionStorage while syncing the 'dark' class on the document root.
frontend/src/hooks/useTSICData.ts: Custom hook that fetches and caches TSIC sensor data for a given numeric ID using React Query, with manual-only refresh behavior.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, including color tokens for backgrounds, typography, chart series, and UI components.
frontend/src/lib/temperatureDataSource.t: Fetches raw temperature and CO2 JSON data from a Google Apps Script endpoint and delegates parsing to temperatureParsing, throwing on invalid responses.
frontend/src/lib/temperatureParsing.ts: Parses raw API data into typed TemperatureDataPoint objects, handling comma-decimal strings, DD/MM/YY timestamps, and optional sensor fields like cooling and flow control.
frontend/src/lib/tsicDataParsing.ts: Parses raw TSIC logger JSON into TSICDataPoint objects with a timestamp and 72 numeric sensor readings (S1–S72), sorting results by timestamp.
frontend/src/lib/tsicDataSource.ts: Fetches TSIC sensor data for a given ID from a Google Apps Script endpoint and delegates parsing to tsicDataParsing, throwing on invalid responses.
frontend/src/logSystems/logSystemPages.t: Defines and exports the list of navigable log system pages (Conceptmachine, TSIC Loggers, Profile), each with an id, display name, subtitle, and associated page component.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page component that renders a centered card with an Internet Identity sign-in button, showing loading and error states during authentication.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: React page for user profile management, allowing users to edit their name, copy their principal ID, and (if admin) grant admin rights to other principals and toggle concept machine visibility.
frontend/src/pages/TemperatureDashboardP: React dashboard page that renders temperature, CO2, cooling/heating/ventilation, and fan voltage charts with shared date-range filtering and synchronized zoom controls.
frontend/src/pages/TSICLogger1Page.tsx: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/pages/TSICLoggersPage.tsx: React page displaying TSIC sensor data charts with controls for selecting a logger ID, filtering by date range, adjusting Y-axis bounds, toggling sensor visibility, and zooming/resetting the time window.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module providing functions to read, persist, and clear URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, using sessionStorage for cross-navigation persistence.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens, extended typography/font/shadow/animation settings, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state metadata tracking the current task (disabling Recharts animations across chart components), existing completed features per component, and one pending action request to apply isAnimationActive={false} globally.
